messages:
elena: FYI drafting changelog entry for 'Pinned KV cache + adaptive routing' feature. Need: 1) short code examples for Python/Node SDKs, 2) migration guidance for Dedicated/private deployments, 3) a short known-issue blurb re: streaming + trailing-newline being doubled in SDK v0.9. Can folks volunteer? I'll open relnotes draft in /docs repo later today.

matt: I can do SDK snippets (py + node). Any preferred token-length examples?

elena: Keep them minimal — one prompt for chat streaming, one for embeddings. Show retry + fallback policy snippet.

sreena: I'll write the Dedicated migration steps. Note: customers on older autoscale stacks need config tweak: set routing.priority=capacity_hints, + mention rollback. Also flag perf caveat: cold-start on pinned cache during first 10k tokens.

matt: quick draft for Node:
```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-kestrel-1', input: 'Summarize the product updates' })
for await (const chunk of res) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta) }
```
Also adding fallback example with `model: ['redwood-kestrel-1','redwood-kestrel-1-quant']` :thumbsup:

elena: perfect. docs-bot: please create a relnotes draft in /docs/releases/ with the feature bullets and attach snippets.

docs-bot: created draft PR #6789 -> https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6789 (assign: @elena @matt @sreena)

sreena: FYI product says known-issue is real: streaming newline duplication happens when client buffer flushes mid-token. Proposed wording: "Known issue: in SDK v0.9 streaming, trailing newline may be duplicated under high flush frequency; workaround: set client.stream_buffer_ms=50 or upgrade to v0.9.1 when available." Agree?

elena: pls include that as a one-line callout under Known issues and add a link to the SDK GH issue. I'll merge once PR has snippets + migration blurb.

matt: pushing snippet PR in 30m. Will also add a quick test harness.

sreena: I'll attach a migration checklist and the autoscale flag sample config in the PR (+ small k8s patch).

elena: thanks all — if no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning and post a short release note in #announcements. :rocket:
